evaluatedFrontmatter:
---
name: humane
description: "Make content easier for people to understand and check. Use when asked to use Humane, make something humane, synthesize or explain documents, compare versions, prepare reader-friendly drafts, tighten wordy text, rewrite stiff prose, or preserve a writer's voice. Lead with what matters to this reader, improve structure and naturalness, and keep important facts, caveats and source references intact. Not an AI detector or a substitute for expert review."
---
method: Only the YAML description changed. The current Markdown body was compared byte-for-byte with commit 2831ce3. Reconstructing the old full document from the exact old frontmatter and current body reproduces the existing behavioral record's full-file SHA-256. Tests retain that check rather than relabeling old responses as fresh trials.
limits: No new model-output trials were run for this metadata-only revision. The forty-case behavioral record and two repeats remain evidence for their original full-file fingerprint.
An unchanged body does not prove that changed discovery metadata has no effect on selection or output. Native automatic triggering across clients and models was not tested.
The official reference validator checks format, metadata and naming; it does not certify editorial quality, human comprehension, or every host's behavior.

referenceValidator.environment: Isolated uv tool environment; no project dependency or user-level skill installation.
